userStories.title: buildRetailerPassport pure function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a pure function that derives the customer-facing passport view data from BatteryPassportData so the passport page has no business logic in the component.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/retailer/buildRetailerPassport.ts exporting: buildRetailerPassport(data: BatteryPassportData): RetailerPassportView

RetailerPassportView type exported from the same file: { batteryModel: string; batteryChemistry: string; grossCapacityKwh: number | null; carbonFootprintKgCo2ePerKwh: number | null; overallGrade: 'A'|'B'|'C'|'D'|'E'; specs: Array<{label: string; value: string}>; flags: Array<{keyword: string; positive: boolean; detail: string}>; categories: Array<{id: string; title: string; grade: 'A'|'B'|'C'|'D'|'E'; summary: string; points: Array<{label: string; value: string; grade: 'A'|'B'|'C'|'D'|'E'}>}> }
overallGrade derives from carbonFootprintPerformanceClassValue ('A'|'B'|'C'|'D'|'E' → same letter; null or unknown → 'C')

specs includes at minimum 4 entries: Capacity (e.g. '625 Wh' from grossCapacityKwh*1000), Voltage (from carbonDeclarationBatteryModelNominalVoltageV, e.g. '36 V'), Chemistry (from batteryChemistry), Weight (from batteryWeight); fallback 'N/A' for nulls

flags has exactly 10 items (5 positive=true, 5 positive=false). Positive flags: (1) 'EU Compliance' if declarationOfConformityRef is set; (2) 'EU Manufacturing' if placeOfManufacture includes 'Germany' or 'Bavaria'; (3) 'Carbon Methodology Declared' if carbonFootprintTotalCalculationBasis is set; (4) 'QR Code Affixed' if qrCodeAffixed is true; (5) 'Fire Safety Declared' if fireExtinguishingAgent is set. Negative flags: (6) 'No Recycled Cobalt' if recycledCobaltPercentage is 0 or null; (7) 'No Recycled Lithium' if recycledLithiumPercentage is 0 or null; (8) 'Preliminary Carbon Class' if carbonFootprintPerformanceClassStatus is 'preliminary'; (9) 'Critical Raw Materials' if criticalRawMaterials is set and non-empty; (10) 'No Renewable Content Data' if renewableContentShare is null or empty string

categories has exactly 5 entries: (1) id='carbon' title='Carbon Footprint' grade from carbonFootprintPerformanceClassValue; (2) id='recycled' title='Recycled Content' grade='D' if both recycled percentages are 0, else 'B'; (3) id='performance' title='Capacity & Performance' grade='A' if grossCapacityKwh >= 0.6; (4) id='compliance' title='Compliance & Conformity' grade='A' if declarationOfConformityRef is set else 'C'; (5) id='origin' title='Manufacturing Origin' grade='A' if placeOfManufacture includes 'Germany' or 'Bavaria' else 'C'. Each category has a summary string and at least 2 data points.

Write src/tests/buildRetailerPassport.test.ts with Vitest tests: (1) given seeded BatteryPassportData shape, overallGrade === 'C'; (2) flags.length === 10; (3) flags.filter(f => f.positive).length === 5; (4) specs.length >= 4; (5) categories.length === 5
npm run typecheck passes
npm test passes

userStories.title: API route GET /api/passport/[passportId]
userStories.description: As the passport page, I need an API endpoint that returns passport data by passportId so the client can render the customer view.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/api/passport/[passportId]/route.ts with a GET handler
Query: prisma.digitalProductPassport.findUnique({ where: { passportId }, include: { batteryData: true } })
Return 200 JSON { passport: { id, passportId, passportUrl, passportType, batteryData } } on success
Return 404 JSON { error: 'Not found' } if no passport matches

userStories.title: Public passport page: bike overview and battery passport screens
userStories.description: As a customer scanning a QR code, I can visit /passport/[passportId] and see a mobile-optimized two-screen Digital Product Passport: a bike overview and a battery passport detail.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/passport/[passportId]/page.tsx as a Next.js server component. It queries prisma directly (no API fetch on server). Passes the result to a client PassportView component. Renders a 404-style message if passportId not found.
Create src/app/passport/[passportId]/PassportView.tsx as a 'use client' component. useState<'bike'|'battery'> for active screen.

BIKE OVERVIEW SCREEN layout (top to bottom): (a) small header bar with 'veloport' wordmark and emerald 'v' logo icon matching the home page nav style; (b) a rounded-2xl card with an e-bike hero image — use ; (c) below the image inside the card: bike name heading ('KTM Macina Sport 720'), subtext 'Digital Product Passport'; (d) a 2-column grid of 4 component cards labeled Frame, Battery, Wheels, Motor. Battery card: bg-white border-emerald-200 border-2, shows GradePill for overallGrade + 'Battery' label + batteryModel subtext + a right arrow icon; clicking it sets page to 'battery'. Other 3 cards: bg-white/60 border-slate-200, same layout but grade pill grayed and a small 'Coming soon' badge, clicking shows nothing (or a toast if preferred).

BATTERY SCREEN layout (top to bottom): (a) top bar with back arrow (ChevronLeft from lucide-react, onClick sets page to 'bike') + 'Battery Passport' title; (b) header card: 'Battery passport' caps label, batteryModel as display heading, specs row (Capacity · Voltage · Weight), GradePill (size lg: 56px box, 28px font) for overallGrade aligned right; (c) FLAGS SECTION: 'ESG Profile' heading, flex-wrap row of 10 flag chips — positive flags styled with bg-green-50 border border-green-200 text-green-800, negative flags styled with bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-800 — each chip shows a colored dot + keyword text, rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium; (d) DEEP DIVE SECTION: 'Category Breakdown' heading, 5 collapsible accordion rows. Each row: rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200 px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-3. Left: stone-colored icon tile (w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center). Middle: title text-sm font-semibold + summary text-xs text-slate-500. Right: GradePill (sm: 28px box) + ChevronDown/Up. Expanded body: border-t border-slate-100 pt-3 mt-3, list of data points each as a row with caps label + value + small grade pill.

STYLING rules: page bg-slate-50 min-h-screen. Container max-w-md mx-auto px-5 py-8. Cards bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm. Text text-slate-900 / text-slate-500. Accent emerald-600. Geist font (inherited from layout). GradePill colors: A bg #166534, B bg #65a30d, C bg #ca8a04, D bg #ea580c, E bg #991b1b — all white text, bold.
Navigating to /passport/BAT-BSH-PT625-2024-008314 with seeded data shows the Bosch PowerTube 625 Wh passport with overallGrade C.
